e.title: Vehicle Insurance MLOps
e.summary: 车险风险预测 MLOps 教学项目：自动化 ML 管线（数据→训练→部署→监控）
e.body: Vehicle Insurance Risk Prediction MLOps 是工业风格的车险风险预测项目：自动化 ML 管线覆盖数据处理、训练、部署与监控全流程。对 RIAA：保险 ML 从建模到上线的完整教学样例——「模型做好只是开始，上线运维才是工程」；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（建模）、[[insurance-governance]]（治理）拼出保险 ML 工程全链；[[rim536]] 大数据课的 MLOps 实践。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库描述确认（工业级 MLOps 管线），未实测
e.summary_en: Vehicle-insurance risk prediction MLOps teaching project: automated ML pipeline (data→train→deploy→monitor)
e.summary_hk: 車險風險預測 MLOps 教學項目：自動化 ML 管線（數據→訓練→部署→監控）
e.body_en: Vehicle Insurance Risk Prediction MLOps is an industry-style project for vehicle-insurance risk prediction: an automated ML pipeline covering data processing, training, deployment and monitoring. For RIAA: a complete teaching sample of insurance ML from modeling to production — building the model is just the start, engineering the deployment is the craft; with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (modeling) and [[insurance-governance]] (governance) it completes the insurance-ML engineering chain; an MLOps practice for the [[rim536]] big-data course.
e.body_hk: Vehicle Insurance Risk Prediction MLOps 是工業風格的車險風險預測項目：自動化 ML 管線覆蓋數據處理、訓練、部署與監控全流程。對 RIAA：保險 ML 從建模到上線的完整教學樣例——「模型做好只是開始，上線運維才是工程」；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（建模）、[[insurance-governance]]（治理）拼出保險 ML 工程全鏈；[[rim536]] 大數據課的 MLOps 實踐。
